blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: зву́чный — resounding, sonorous; нау́чный — scientific; поря́дочный — decent, honest, respectable; привы́чный — habitual, customary, usual.
**усло́вный** — conditional (depending upon a condition). Wiktionary: усло́вие + -ный.
**це́нный** — valuable, precious, costly, dear. Wiktionary: цена́ + -ный.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: обыкнове́нный — usual, ordinary, habitual; усло́вный — conditional (depending upon a condition); це́нный — valuable, precious, costly, dear; собо́рный — (relational) cathedral.
